Description: This registry defines the update messages for Nvidia.

ComponentUpdateSkipped.Description: Indicates that update of component has been skipped
ComponentUpdateSkipped.Message: The update operation for the component %1 is skipped because %2.

ComponentUpdateTime.Description: Indicates the time taken to update a component
ComponentUpdateTime.Message: The update operation for component '%1' completed in '%2'.

DebugTokenAlreadyInstalled.Description: Indicates that the device has a token already installed and cannot finish current request.
DebugTokenAlreadyInstalled.Message: Debug token for device '%1' has already been installed.

DebugTokenInstallationSuccess.Description: Signifies the successful completion of debug token installation.
DebugTokenInstallationSuccess.Message: The operation to install a debug token for device '%1' has been successfully completed.

DebugTokenRequestSuccess.Description: Signifies the successful completion of the debug token request.
DebugTokenRequestSuccess.Message: The operation to request a debug token for device '%1' has been successfully completed.

DebugTokenStatusSuccess.Description: Signifies the successful completion of the debug token status request.
DebugTokenStatusSuccess.Message: The operation to obtain a token status for device '%1' has been successfully completed.

DebugTokenUnsupported.Description: Indicates that the device does not support debug token functionality.
DebugTokenUnsupported.Message: Device '%1' does not support debug token functionality.

DebugTokenEraseFailed.Description: Indicates that debug token erase operation has failed for the device.
DebugTokenEraseFailed.Message: The operation to erase a debug token for device '%1' has failed with error '%2'

RecoveryStarted.Description: Indicates that recovery has started on a component

RecoverySuccessful.Description: Indicates that recovery has successfully completed on a component

FirmwareInRecovery.Description: Indicates that device had boot failure and currently entered firmware recovery mode which requires external fw recovery

FirmwareNotInRecovery.Description: Indicates that a firmware is not in Recovery Mode

DOTActionResponseError.Description: Indicates that an error occured for the requested DOT command.
DOTActionResponseError.Message: Requested DOT action has resulted in error of type '%1'.

DOTMCTPStatusError.Description: Indicates that an MCTP error occured for the requested DOT command.
DOTMCTPStatusError.Message: Requested DOT action has resulted in MCTP error of type '%1'.

EnterDOTRecovery.Description: Indicates that the device has accepted an empty DOT blob and has successfully entered DOT recovery mode.
EnterDOTRecovery.Message: The device %1 has accepted an empty DOT Blob and has successfully entered DOT recovery mode.
EnterDOTRecovery.Resolution: Perform an L1 reset, then proceed with a second firmware recovery update to initiate DOT recovery NSM commands, such as DOTOverride.

HeaderValueInvalid.Description: Indicates that a header value is invalid.
HeaderValueInvalid.Message: Header value '%1' for header '%2' is invalid expected value is '%3'.
HeaderValueInvalid.Resolution: Check the header value and expected value and resubmit the request again.

ImageCopyCompleted.Description: Indicates that image copy had already been completed successfully.
ImageCopyCompleted.Message: Image copy had already been completed successfully for '%1'.

DebugTokenEraseSkipped.Description: Indicates that the debug token erase operation was skipped for the device.
DebugTokenEraseSkipped.Message: Debug token erase operation is skipped because %1.

DebugTokenEraseSuccess.Description: Signifies the successful completion of debug token erase.
DebugTokenEraseSuccess.Message: The operation to erase a debug token for device '%1' has been successfully completed.

DebugTokenNotInstalled.Description: Indicates that no debug token was installed on the device.
DebugTokenNotInstalled.Message: Debug token is not installed on device '%1'.

DebugTokenInstallationFailed.Description: Indicates that debug token installation operation has failed for the device.
DebugTokenInstallationFailed.Message: The operation to install a debug token for device '%1' has failed with error '%2'

ActivateSuccessful.Description: Indicates that image is successfully activated on the device
ActivateSuccessful.Message: Device %1 is successfully activated with image %2.

Name: Nvidia Message Registry
